en-US.longDescription: FolderSync is the ultimate file sync software for professionals and home users alike. Our tool makes it simple to sync folders between your computer and the cloud, ensuring your data is always up-to-date. Set up a file sync job in minutes and never worry about manual backups again. Whether you need to sync files for work or personal projects, our solution is built for reliability.
